name: dsh-ai-curfew
description: AI 熄灯：让 AI 也下班。到点后回复越来越短，深夜把 max_tokens 从 2048 压到 64，凌晨三点只回一句「明天再说」；高峰时段不上班，已下班照样收消息但只回一个句号。零 token、零成本。

meta.title: AI Curfew
meta.description: Clock the AI off duty: shrinking replies after curfew, max_tokens 2048→64 overnight, and a bare full stop once it is off the clock. No request is sent, so it costs zero tokens.
